book.title: Spelled Guilty
book.subtitle: Murder Mystery Word Search for Adults: 80 Whodunit Cases — Find the Words, Read the Leftover Clue, Name the Killer
book.author: Pau Monfort

notes.art: 1100 px wide, pure white background (255): place with mix-blend-mode: multiply over a paper colour. Each image is a line-up of four suspects A-D.
notes.stickers: Transparent WebP (alpha) with the thin white die-cut rim already included.
notes.flipbook: Spoiler-free: no hints (printed p168-173), no solutions (p174-213), no copyright page (p2).
notes.marketing: Built for Amazon A+ content (navy, cream and red brand look). Text inside the images is baked in, in English.
notes.graphics: Transparent WebP brand elements taken from the cover design (title lettering, taped clue note).

flipbook.readingOrder: Front cover (cover-front.webp) stands alone on the right; then 8 spreads [seq 1,2], [3,4] ... [15,16] (left, right); back cover (cover-back.webp) stands alone.
flipbook.pagesPerImage: 900 x 1350 px = 6 x 9 in at 150 dpi (lossless WebP)
flipbook.cover: cover-front.webp (single, right-hand) -> then the 16 pages as 8 spreads (left, right) -> cover-back.webp
flipbook.note: Sequence is designed so that spreads pair up exactly (seq 1+2, 3+4, ...). Case files are always on the left and their word search on the right, as in the printed book. Page 1 (title) is a right-hand page in print but is shown on the left here, next to page 3, so no blank filler page is needed; the copyright page (p2) is intentionally skipped. No hints (p168-173), no solutions (p174-213).
